mentions.name: Agent harness with automated reviews
mentions.description: An agent harness: a system and process with automated reviews to steer AI agents, ground them, and ensure consistency while still giving them enough leeway to exploit their full capabilities; not ready to share yet.
mentions.problem: Agent drift is a huge pain, and without this system the author would keep teetering on the edge of burnout.
mentions.source_excerpt: Aside from that, some sort of agent harness I guess we call them? Putting together a "system" / "process" with automated reviews to both steer agents, ground them (drift is a huge pain), and somehow ensure consistency while giving them enough leeway to exploit their full capabilities. Nothing ready to share yet, but I feel that without it I’ll just keep teetering on the edge of burnout.
